name: After § 4
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 4a. Calls for the EU to adopt a strategy to counter any form of separatism and religious entryism; recalls that such a strategy should not target the followers of any religion, but rather counter the instrumentalisation of religion where it is used to undermine the EU’s democratic fabric;
